title: Crossfade
description: A DJ crossfader between two Beatles records. Drag the fader and the covers dissolve into each other, the light parts of the incoming record leading the way while both artworks drift gently in scale. The track title hands over cleanly at the centre and the master tempo glides between the two decks' BPM.
intent: One fader drives everything: a soft, light-led dissolve between two covers, the title handover and the master tempo.
